Criterion: none stated by the authors (descriptive, exploratory survey of student perceptions). Quality verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. Cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: Inexperienced cohort with no own process to compare (assessment may be favourable); 13 respondents from one cohort, not generalisable; results are perceived, not observed behaviour. Open issues: confidence vs comprehension gap; repository-local instructions need maintenance (forgotten conventions, files growing too large); artefacts not updated automatically across team members' agents; ADRs rarely used; need lightweight path for small changes; add security/monitoring step. Future: repeat with later and more experienced cohorts; objective measures (code quality, coverage, adherence, review activity)
